cohort: Women with meconium-stained amniotic fluid during labor who delivered at term (37 to 41(+6) weeks of gestation) in a tertiary hospital between 2007-2013
finding: Meconium-stained amniotic fluid is associated with a higher rate of adverse perinatal outcomes, including operative delivery, caesarean section, respiratory morbidity, and short-term neonatal morbidity, even in low-risk pregnancies at term.
mod_finding: MSAF was associated with operative delivery and cesarean section.
